response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share_pct, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS avg_share_pct FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - avg_share_pct) AS average_excess_pct FROM compared WHERE share_pct > avg_share_pct;
